name: Cybersecurity Homelab
desc: Seven-VM enterprise simulation on Proxmox: pfSense, Kali, Metasploitable, DVWA/WebGoat, a Windows Server 2022 AD domain, and Security Onion.

name: Enterprise IT Support Lab
desc: Active Directory, Group Policy, PowerShell, NTFS permissions, and an osTicket help desk for working realistic support tickets.

name: wg2 RAT Teardown
desc: Full annotated Ghidra decompilation of an HTTP RAT: bit-shift C2 obfuscation, SSL certificate bypass, 11-command protocol and token-theft privilege escalation.

name: SQL Slammer Worm Teardown
desc: Commented disassembly and stack-layout study of a 376-byte UDP worm: stack-overflow entry, stack-built API strings, a lea/shift-only random IP generator and a sendto() spread loop.

name: Malware Analysis Labs
desc: Reverse-engineered a RAT and a SQL worm in IDA Pro and Ghidra, and patched out SIDT/SLDT/STR anti-VM checks.

name: HiTek Digital Forensics Challenge
desc: Team investigation of an insider data exfiltration: cracked six accounts, carved deleted ZIPs from unallocated space, and rebuilt the FTP-to-HTTP exfil chain from two disk images and a PCAP.

name: ERU
desc: Team social media app: Spring Boot + MongoDB backend and a React Native (Expo) frontend with a feed, uploads, comments, likes and profiles.

name: Room'r
desc: Swipe-style roommate matching app: lifestyle questionnaire, weighted compatibility score, bidirectional dealbreakers, chat with icebreakers and push notifications.

name: Supermarket DBMS
desc: Multi-branch supermarket database in SQLite: normalized schema, transactional checkout, 16 named reports and a Python CLI.

name: JavaShooter
desc: My first game: an infinite roguelike shooter in Java with chaser enemies, bosses and level-up upgrades. Source on GitHub, lessons in the write-up.
